svg.title: Separate evidence layers and shared-edge capacity
svg.desc: Physical connectivity, directional runtime support and measured transfer behavior are different layers. Two same-direction flows demanding 24 GB/s exceed a constructed shared 16 GB/s edge.

g.text: Connectivity, permission, route evidence and performance differ
An NVLink label does not prove every peer copy used it.
A successful peer-access query does not certify one-direction bandwidth.
GPU D2H + NIC ingress both traverse this direction
Both rates cannot be sustained on that edge
Two 16 MiB payloads need ≥ 2.097152 ms of shared-edge payload service.
Constructed usable capacity; excludes fixed overhead and all measured claims.
Changed identity or link state → invalidate the claim and collect fresh evidence.
